note: Machine-readable surface manifest for the curated workflow launchers (tests assert ledger completeness against this file; the full 56-reference disposition ledger with observed purpose, resource dependency and validation status lives in the private Phase-13 state doc). Every curated launcher is a thin wrapper that executes exactly: call "<this-dir>\dfl.bat" <mapped arguments>; exit-code propagation is inherited. Paths inside mapped commands are relative to the repository root (dfl.bat sets the working directory).

Requires external user-supplied pretraining data passed explicitly through --pretraining-data-dir; no dataset is bundled or downloaded. The generic dfl.bat train surface provides this path contract, so a dedicated fixed-resource launcher is not shipped.
